subject: general
question: The word "match" is a homonym. In which sentence does it mean something used to light a fire?

options.text: The match between her dress and shoes was perfect.
The cricket match was postponed due to rain.
He struck a match to light the candle.
They are a good match for each other.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. He struck a match to light the candle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"match"** is a homonym, meaning it has multiple meanings depending on the context. (समान ध्वनि वाले शब्द)
 
 
• In this context, **"match"** refers to a small wooden or cardboard stick coated with a chemical substance that ignites when struck against a rough surface. (माचिस)
 
 
 
• **Example:** He struck a match to light the campfire.
 

**Explanation of the correct word:**

 
• Here, the correct meaning of the word "match" is a tool used to light a fire or candle. (माचिस)
 
 
 
• **Example:** She used a match to light the stove.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. He struck a match to light the candle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The match between her dress and shoes was perfect. (मेल): Here, "match" refers to compatibility or harmony between two things.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The color of the curtains and the walls is a perfect match.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The cricket match was postponed due to rain. (खेल): In this case, "match" refers to a competitive game or sport.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The football match was thrilling to watch.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** They are a good match for each other. (समान): Here, "match" means a pair or a suitable partner.
 
 
 
• **Example:** The couple is a perfect match for each other.
